CUSTOMER_DELIVERABLE.description: May be distributed only on an approved customer/release surface.

CACE_TRADE_SECRET.description: Crown-jewel proprietary implementation/theorem material; release prohibited absent explicit executive/security/legal exception.

rules.reason: internal proof roadmap and qualification planning
internal verification/build/release tooling unless explicitly exported
internal tests may expose implementation details and negative cases
internal security policies/scanners; customer security summary may be separately generated
browser-facing application assets subject to production bundle secrecy gate
current Python implementation is inspectable and requires explicit release allowlist/native migration for protected modules

hard_rules: No CACE_TRADE_SECRET path may enter an ordinary customer application artifact.
CACE_CONFIDENTIAL paths require an explicit allowlist exception before customer distribution.
Customer delivery manifests record any exception and the approving policy version.
Classification is a release-control label, not a mathematical evidence class.
